label: Geomantic siting logic shapes Arcadia development
plain: Feng shui traditions — Form School landform reading, and possibly Compass School practices (BaZi timing, Xuan Kong / Flying Star orientation) — materially shape siting, orientation, design, timing, and pricing of Arcadia real estate.
tradition_classification: Documented Arcadia practices classify as Form-School-adjacent orientation/lot-position preferences fused with resale arithmetic, plus homophone numerology (4/8 addresses and prices). No Compass-School consultation, BaZi timing, or named per-project adviser is documented for Arcadia (gm-r01, gm-r05, gm-r11).
notes: Documented adjacent mechanisms: LA Times-reported feng shui-informed teardown siting with named designers (Tong, Chan); peer-reviewed 4/8 address premia in a comparable market (Vancouver); a feng-shui-master-selected 8/8/2017 groundbreaking in Tacoma. Absence of a named adviser for any specific Arcadia project is a coverage result (cov-04), not proof none existed. Cultural correlation is never ethnic command, coordination, or a supernatural claim.

label: Ley-line / mana-sieve energy reading of the landscape
plain: The alluvial fan, the washes, the racetrack crowds, and the money flows form an energy-like system ('ley lines', 'mana sieve') that the built environment harvests.
tradition_classification: Ley lines are a Western esoteric tradition (Watkins 1922/1925; respiritualized by Michell 1969, who borrowed the Chinese 'lung mei' concept one-way). Applying them to Arcadia imports a Western New Age frame absent from the documented practices of this market (gm-r10).
notes: The physical substrate is real (alluvial-fan recharge, fault-bounded groundwater, crowd/capital flows through the track), and the metaphor is preserved as expressed; no literal energetic mechanism is asserted or supported. No feng shui siting lore about the racetrack itself was found after search (cov-06).

label: First Avenue precision implies orientation intent
plain: The 'laser level' precision of the current First Avenue works reflects an orientation or alignment intent beyond engineering necessity.
tradition_classification: If real, this would be a geomantic-orientation practice; nothing in the documented record supports it.
notes: The documented scope (grind-and-overlay, curbs, ramps, bulb-outs, Prop C/STPL funding) supplies an ordinary engineering explanation, and the claimed First/Huntington/Valencia geometry was rejected against retrieved plans (con-13). Preserved because absence of documentation of intent is not disproof of intent; graph effect stays none either way.

label: A single controlling man behind the formation
plain: One person sits behind the Arcadia formation, with the conversation trying Baldwin, Strub, Kaufmann, Chandler, Stronach, Wahl, and Rao in the role at different moments.
tradition_classification: Not a geomantic claim; a single-agent causal hypothesis.
notes: The temporal control map contradicts the singular framing: these candidates occupy different, mostly non-overlapping regimes and functions (see chronology.json and rejected-joins rj-03). Among the layers documented in this reconstruction, Baldwin (1903-1909) alone held all of them concurrently; the modern formation is multi-actor, and bounded corridor comparisons support structural mechanisms without completing every control stage (con-08). Preserved and searchable; graph effect none.
